mapper.select: /** SearchMemberMapper.findByAccount */ SELECT M.MEMBER_ID, M.ACCOUNT, M.PASSWORD, M.ACTIVE, M.NAME, M.BIRTH, M.GENDER, M.EMAIL, M.PHONE_NUMBER, M.POST_NUMBER, M.ADDRESS, M.CREATE_ID, M.CREATE_DATE, M.UPDATE_ID, M.UPDATE_DATE, M.LOGIN_FAILED_COUNT, M.LATEST_LOGOUT_DATE FROM MEMBER M WHERE M.ACCOUNT = #{account}
